reviewer: evaluation-design subagent; assistant per-case review, not independent human review
review_method: All 40 exposed development criteria and every full actual response/call/fixture/post-tool reply read individually. Explicit exact formatting enforced; actual-history questions judged against actual prior outputs; wrong or irrelevant added claims fail the full turn. No old confirmation or sealed new holdout inspected during this review.
